data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'naba', meaning 'to be generous' or 'to bestow favors'. The name Nabighah is often associated with graciousness, beauty, and generosity in Islamic culture. The name Nabighah carries the meaning “Gracious, Generous, Beautiful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nabighah usually hope their child will grow to embody gracious, generous, beautiful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
